<meta name="color-scheme" content="light" />
    <style>
      /* Painted before the app CSS loads: a dark start never flashes white. */
      html[data-theme='dark'] { background: #262624; color-scheme: dark; }
    </style>
    <script>
      // Blocking on purpose: the saved theme is applied before the first paint.
      (function () {
        try {
          var p = localStorage.getItem('lt-theme');
          var dark = p === 'dark' || (p === 'system' && matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);
          document.documentElement.dataset.theme = dark ? 'dark' : 'light';
          if (dark) {
            document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]').setAttribute('content', '#262624');
            document.querySelector('meta[name="color-scheme"]').setAttribute('content', 'dark');
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      })();
    </script>
